title: 36 Hours in the Cinque Terre, Italy
abstract: It’s almost unfair how much intense beauty, great cuisine and amazing aromas are jampacked into such a compact space.

title: 36 Hours in Budapest
abstract: Like the blue Danube River that separates Castle Hill in Buda from the flâneur-worthy boulevards of Pest, the Hungarian capital has a sophisticated and hedonistic side.

title: 36 Hours in Frankfurt
abstract: Shorn of its master-of-the-universe pretensions, the city has rediscovered its essential charm as a user-friendly Hessian town with big-city accouterments.

title: 36 Hours in Ottawa
abstract: Beneath Ottawa’s buttoned-up, civil-servant demeanor lies a surprisingly vibrant community, with enough green space to satisfy the most hyperactive of travelers.
